Game Overview

In Weapon Master, the core idea is straightforward: sharpen your skills in Weapon Master, a thrilling knife-throwing challenge. Perfect your aim, avoid previous hits, and strike bullseyes on spinning targets. Master timing, unlock powerful blades, and conquer each test with precision. Will you become the ultimate knife-throwing champion?
